propositions: External and live-service CI pytest lanes lack per-test hang guards, allowing deadlocked tests to hide behind output with no traceback or culprit identification.
Eight unguarded pytest lanes across six workflows need individual per-test timeout budgets calibrated from historical runtime data, ranging from 300s to 3600s based on observed step duration.

Detection rule must exhaustively match all four pytest invocation forms in .github/workflows files (bare pytest, pytest -m, python -m pytest, path-prefixed python) and reject non-pytest command text like pip install lines and shell comments.
Per-test hang guard implementation requires both --timeout= and --timeout-method=thread flags on every pytest-invoking step, with per-lane budgets audited via YAML comments at the step.
_optionality.yml's degradation-path lane must install pytest-timeout to the minimal venv so the timeout flag is honored rather than erroring as unknown.
